svg.aria-label: A trie with cached top results. Each node is a prefix and stores the 2 most popular queries below it, for example the root and the prefixes c and ca store cat 40 and car 35, and car stores car 35 and card 22. Typing ca means walking two steps from the root and reading the cached answer, cat and car, without searching the subtree.
svg.title: Trie with cached top-k
